_comment: Per-event external media links. Each event id maps to optional photos/videos/sets arrays of { url, label? }. Empty arrays are ignored. Example: "116039": { "photos": [{ "url": "https://www.instagram.com/p/...", "label": "Recap reel" }], "sets": [{ "url": "https://soundcloud.com/...", "label": "After June live" }] }
